items.name: Mississippi Pot Roast with Mixed Roasted Potatoes & Carrots
items.desc: This might be comfort food or Sunday-after-church fare, but this healthy take on a classic pot roast recipe results in a very delicious meal full of clean ingredients and whole foods!

items.name: Cuban Chicken & Black Bean Rice Bowl
items.desc: Cilantro, lime, rice, and Cuban-style black beans serve as the base for this juicy chicken tossed in a blend of flavors that are full of life and tastiness.

items.name: Lemon Chicken Pasta
items.desc: Fresh, vibrant, and simple, this herby Lemon Chicken Pasta Bowl is fit for any light lunch or dinner, and is tasty heated or eaten cold.

items.name: Breakfast Meatballs
items.desc: Meatballs in the morning? You betcha! Tasty breakfast sausage-inspired meatballs are paired with cheesy polenta and soft scrambled eggs for a fun new twist on breakfast!

items.name: Autumn Butternut Squash Soup
items.desc: This is hands down the best butternut squash soup you'll put in your belly!  Healthy, nourishing, AND delicious!!

items.name: Scotcheroo Energy Bites
items.desc: We've taken a favorite indulgent snack and given it a healthful boost! A smart way to have a sweet treat or a midafternoon pick-me-up. At 5g protein per ball of goodness, these whole-food treats will treat your body well!

items.name: Take & Bake Enchilada Chicken & Rice Casserole (6 servings)
items.desc: Simple and nostalgic - fresh and juicy chicken, black beans, corn, cheese and rice come together in this dish that will take you back and keep you moving forward on your goals.
